author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices clapping patterns, steady beat, finding E, echoing three notes, hearing same and different, and taking turns, with an old clapping rhyme.

classes.title: Pat, clap, porridge hot
classes.goal: Keep a pat-clap pattern going together while the rhyme plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two moves, pat then clap, again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Sit facing your child: pat your knees, then clap hands, on each beat.
classes.childAction: Pat your knees, clap your hands. Pat, clap, all song long.
classes.bridge: Pat is the spoon in the pot; clap is the lid going on.

intro.caption: Pat, clap, pat, clap
intro.parentCue: sit facing your child and show it slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pat-clap pattern, together.

classes.title: Stir the porridge beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap for every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each beat. Hot lasts two taps!
classes.bridge: Each beat is one stir of the spoon: stir, stir, stir.

intro.caption: One beat, one stir
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find E, the porridge key
classes.goal: Find the special note E by using the two black keys as a landmark.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding a place by what sits next to it

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide right, and press E gently.
classes.bridge: E is the pot, sitting just right of the two black keys.

intro.caption: Where does E live?
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Echo: E, E, D
classes.goal: Hold three notes in mind, then copy them back on the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping three sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to three notes, then play the same three back.
classes.bridge: Pease, por-ridge: two Es, then one step down to D.

intro.caption: I call, you answer
intro.parentCue: say 'pease porridge', let your child copy

games.caption: Pease por-ridge: E, E, D
games.parentCue: Hold up fingers: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying three notes.

classes.title: Hot ending, cold ending
classes.goal: Echo two lines that start the same and end differently: hot and cold.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same start, different last note: that is how we tell them apart

classes.parentPrompt: Fan your face for 'hot', hug and shiver for 'cold'.
classes.childAction: Play hot: E, E, D, C. Play cold: E, E, D, D.
classes.bridge: Hot walks all the way down to C; cold stops on D.

intro.caption: Hot or cold? Listen!
intro.parentCue: fan your face for hot, shiver for cold

games.caption: Hot! E, E, D, C
games.parentCue: Fan your face on the last note

games.caption: Cold! E, E, D, D
games.parentCue: Shiver together on the last note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing same and different endings.

classes.title: Two Es to start
classes.goal: Wait and listen, then play the two Es that start each line.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each line starts with two Es: one, two

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; hold up two fingers and count 'one, two' as your child plays.
classes.childAction: Wait for your turn, then play E, E: one, two!
classes.bridge: Two Es are two spoons into the pot: one, two.

intro.caption: Wait, wait, now it's E!
intro.parentCue: hands in lap until the E comes

games.caption: Two Es: one, two
games.parentCue: Hold up two fingers and count

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting your turn and counting two.

classes.title: Clapping partners
classes.goal: Play the whole rhyme together, like two partners in a clapping game.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play your blue keys and smile; if your child misses an E, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play your E notes while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: Like clapping partners: your hands and mine take turns to make one game.

intro.caption: Partners, ready? Let's play!
intro.parentCue: clap palms with your child once to start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, taking turns.

classes.title: Hot and cold concert
classes.goal: Play the whole rhyme for teddy, from the first line to the last.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play together, then clap palms and bow at the end.
classes.childAction: Play your notes to the end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The rhyme is one pot of porridge: hot, then cold, then nine days old.

intro.caption: A rhyme for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
